purpose: Define the canonical artifact classes, lifecycle profiles, verification requirements, release-channel eligibility, activation behavior, recovery behavior, and retention expectations used by kOA.

global_invariants.statement: Every artifact instance declares exactly one registered artifact class.
Every artifact instance validates against the schema registered for its artifact class.
Published immutable artifacts are never modified in place; a change creates a new version or replacement instance.
Activation never creates partial authoritative state.
Every artifact class defines rollback, rejection, revocation, recreation, or forward-repair behavior.
A Release Set binds tested compatible versions across the system, services, governance, and knowledge channels.
Independent release-channel updates are valid only when declared compatibility constraints remain satisfied.
A transport bundle carries artifacts but does not independently grant them authority.
A request is not evidence that its requested operation was approved or executed.
A receipt records an event and cannot be used to rewrite the event it records.
File-content hashes are not required for ordinary Markdown documentation; artifact digests and signatures are used only where the artifact contract requires integrity verification.
A Space definition, module interface manifest, route contribution, sidebar contribution, or top-bar widget never grants authority or bypasses the owning system authorization path.
An integration resilience policy never converts a failed or open remote dependency into authoritative success.
A dead-letter record preserves failed asynchronous work until authorized redrive, authorized discard, or superseding repair is evidenced.
A distributed workflow exposes pending and partial states and reaches a receipted terminal, compensated, or forward-repair outcome.
A large payload remains in owner-controlled object storage while control messages carry only a bounded verified reference.
An experience view adapter shapes presentation but owns no business authority, business data, or cross-owner transaction.
A CQRS read projection is non-authoritative, command-free, staleness-bounded, and rebuildable from its declared owner source.
A cache is non-authoritative, tenant-scoped, bounded by TTL and invalidation rules, and safe when empty or unavailable.

versioned_configuration.description: Lifecycle for a versioned configuration or policy artifact.
versioned_configuration.mutation_policy: A published version is immutable. Changes create a new version.

immutable_receipt.description: Lifecycle for an append-only record of a completed governed event.
immutable_receipt.mutation_policy: A receipt is immutable after issuance. Corrections require a linked replacement receipt.

governed_request.description: Lifecycle for a request that requires validation and an explicit outcome.
governed_request.mutation_policy: Request history is append-only after submission.

deployable_package.description: Lifecycle for a versioned package that can be published and activated.
deployable_package.mutation_policy: A published package is immutable. Rebuilds produce a new version and provenance chain.

release_binding.description: Lifecycle for a verified binding of compatible release-channel versions.
release_binding.mutation_policy: A published Release Set is immutable and names exact compatible channel versions.

transport_bundle.description: Lifecycle for a sealed package transferred across a connectivity boundary.
transport_bundle.mutation_policy: A sealed bundle is immutable. Any content change requires a newly assembled bundle.

workspace_definition.description: Lifecycle for a reproducible development workspace definition.
workspace_definition.mutation_policy: Mutable runtime state is external to the workspace definition. Definition changes create a new revision.

allocation_record.description: Lifecycle for an exclusive, time-bounded or workspace-bounded allocation.
allocation_record.mutation_policy: Allocation history is append-only. Reassignment creates a new allocation record.

quarantined_operational_record.description: Lifecycle for a quarantined asynchronous record that requires review and explicit closure.
quarantined_operational_record.mutation_policy: The original failure record is immutable; review and closure actions append linked evidence.

long_running_workflow.description: Lifecycle for a multi-owner transition with explicit pending, compensation, repair, and terminal states.
long_running_workflow.mutation_policy: State transitions append evidence; completed owner actions are not rewritten.

ephemeral_authorized_reference.description: Lifecycle for a bounded object reference retained through workflow completion and then cleaned according to owner policy.
ephemeral_authorized_reference.mutation_policy: The referenced payload remains owner-controlled; reference replacement creates a new reference identity.

rebuildable_projection.description: Lifecycle for a non-authoritative read projection that can be invalidated and rebuilt from its declared owner source.
rebuildable_projection.mutation_policy: Projection contents are disposable and rebuilt from the canonical source; projection state never becomes owner state.

cultural_rights_policy.description: Machine-readable policy governing cultural rights, consent, permitted use, disclosure, and revocation conditions.

decision_receipt.description: Immutable record of a governed decision, relevant inputs, authority, outcome, and resulting state transition.

developer_workspace.description: Reproducible declaration of one development workspace, its identity, isolated dependencies, services, data namespaces, secrets, and local allocations.

integration_manifest.description: Versioned declaration of an external integration, approved capabilities, data boundaries, authentication mode, failure behavior, and removal behavior.

node_profile.description: Machine-readable declaration of a node's selected deployment profile, overlays, capabilities, constraints, and conformance claims.

offline_bundle.description: Sealed transport package used to move approved artifacts and their verification material into a disconnected environment.

policy_bundle.description: Versioned package of governance policies, policy metadata, compatibility constraints, and activation instructions.

release_set.description: Verified binding of tested compatible versions across the system, services, governance, and knowledge release channels.

sovereignty_bundle.description: Package containing the artifacts, policies, manifests, receipts, and evidence required for a declared sovereign deployment operation.

runtime_pack.description: Versioned package consumed by a runtime component, containing runtime-ready assets and a manifest but no authoring workspace.

language_pack.description: Versioned package of SemantiK Architect runtime language assets and metadata. A pack may contain GF/PGF assets, family-renderer resources, safe-mode resources, lexicon/runtime data, or a compatible combination declared by the SemantiK Architect contract.

publication_request.description: Request submitted to the Publication Gateway for a controlled release of selected information across an authority or security boundary.

publication_receipt.description: Immutable record of a Publication Gateway decision, released content identity, applied policy, destination, and outcome.

provenance_receipt.description: Immutable record of artifact origin, transformation, transfer, verification, and acceptance history.

resource_envelope.description: Versioned declaration of CPU, memory, I/O, concurrency, queue, and process limits for a component, profile, or workload class.

workspace_port_allocation.description: Exclusive allocation of host ports and related service endpoints to one identified development workspace.

shared_mediatheque_frame.description: Portable authority-preserving interchange record used by the kOA and UCKK Mediatheques.

uckk_learning_package.description: Selected UCKK course, learning path, instruction collection, manual, or resource graph prepared for controlled local and offline use.

uckk_import_receipt.description: Immutable evidence of UCKK learning-package retrieval, validation, acceptance, rejection, and local identity creation.

space_definition.description: Validated configuration selecting and arranging interface modules, public aliases, navigation order, and offline presentation behavior for one kOA Space.

module_interface_manifest.description: Module-owned presentation manifest contributing routes, sidebar entries, top-bar widgets, labels, capability requirements, and offline behavior to kOA Spaces.

space_activation_receipt.description: Immutable evidence of Space validation, dependency resolution, activation, rejection, rollback, and selected interface-manifest versions.

integration_resilience_policy.description: Canonical integration resilience policy artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

dead_letter_record.description: Canonical dead-letter record artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

distributed_workflow.description: Canonical distributed workflow artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

large_payload_reference.description: Canonical large payload reference artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

experience_view_adapter.description: Canonical experience view adapter artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

cqrs_projection.description: Canonical CQRS projection artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.

cache_policy.description: Canonical cache policy artifact defined by the architecture-pattern policy.
